title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of Yabawon in the Municipality of Jones, Province of Romblon
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of Yabawon in the Municipality of Jones, Province of Romblon
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Barrio Yabawon tại Đô thị Jones, Tỉnh Romblon
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งบาริโอ Yabawon ในเทศบาล Jones จังหวัด Romblon
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Barrio Yabawon di Kotamadya Jones, Provinsi Romblon
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Barrio Yabawon di Perbandaran Jones, Wilayah Romblon

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1014_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios known as Mahaba, Angomon, Solocan, Kapanranan and Yabawon in the municipality of Jones, Province of Romblon, are hereby constituted into a separate and independent barrio to be known as the barrio of Yabawon.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 12, 1954.
